title: Jesus... I Can't Remember The Last Time I Did Something For Me
topic: no time for himself anymore, everything is for others

bible.text: Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I can't remember the last time I did something just for me. 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Work, family calls, helping everyone. My whole week belongs to other people.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You gave away your Sunday, your evenings, even your lunch break. I saw every piece you handed out.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Isn't that what a good son does? What a good friend does?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: It is. But you didn't leave yourself a single seat in your own week, and even I rested.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I feel guilty resting when everyone around me needs something.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Rest isn't stealing from them. A poured-out cup cannot pour again. Sit with Me tonight.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I honestly don't know what I'd even do with an hour that was mine.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Then start small. One hour, no phone, no favours. Just you and Me remembering who you are.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: The world will not fall apart if you rest tonight. I'm holding it.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: When did you last do something just for you? 🙏
